question: Find the value of (2)/(3) div (12)/(11) { of } 8(1)/(4) + 4(1)/(7) - 5(1)/(2) times 1(1)/(7) + 5(1)/(3) .
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Convert mixed fractions: 8 1/4 = 33/4, 4 1/7 = 29/7, 5 1/2 = 11/2, 1 1/7 = 8/7, 5 1/3 = 16/3 First solve “of”: 12/11 of 33/4 = 9 Then 2/3 ÷ 9 = 2/27 Now simplify: 2/27 + 29/7 − 44/7 + 16/3 ⇒ 2/27 − 15/7 + 16/3 = 617/189 **∴ Answer = 617/189**
